title: What's new in Expense Agent: Mobile App (Preview)
summary: This video shows the new Expense Agent mobile app for iOS and Android. The presenter demos scanning several receipts with auto capture, sending receipts from the phone gallery through the share function, and creating mileage expenses. The video then covers offline mode, where receipts are stored and only processed once the phone is back online. It also shows submitting expense reports and the full approver experience on the phone. The app is in preview and beta, and the video closes with how to try it.

Preview status and how to try the app

features.name: Scan receipts with auto capture
features.description: From the plus button the user picks scan receipts and the phone's native auto capture grabs the receipt automatically. Several receipts can be captured in one go and are uploaded and processed by the Expense Agent once the user clicks next.
features.status_evidence_quote: But be mindful because it's still in preview.
caveats: Processing and recognition work the same way as in the Business Central web app
prerequisites: Business Central environment that supports the Expense Agent
Expense Agent mobile app installed on iOS or Android

features.name: Upload receipts from gallery or files via share
features.description: Existing receipt pictures can be sent to the Expense Agent from the phone gallery with the operating system share function, where the agent appears in the list of supported apps. The plus menu also offers a choose from files option.
features.status_evidence_quote: But be mindful because it's still in preview.
prerequisites: Expense Agent mobile app installed on iOS or Android

features.name: Mileage expenses on mobile
features.description: Users create a mileage expense from the phone by entering a destination, choosing from route options and picking a vehicle type. The distance and rate are calculated, and the experience is similar to the web app.
features.status_evidence_quote: But be mindful because it's still in preview.
caveats: Distance is shown in miles in the demo
prerequisites: Expense Agent mobile app installed on iOS or Android

features.name: Automatic categorization into expense reports
features.description: After expenses are uploaded, the agent recognizes them and sorts them into expense reports. In the demo it matched a receipt to an existing training report and created new reports for the other expenses.
features.status_evidence_quote: But be mindful because it's still in preview.
prerequisites: Business Central environment that supports the Expense Agent

features.name: Offline mode
features.description: Without a connection, users can still add receipts to the app. Nothing is processed locally; the receipts are kept and uploaded and processed by the Expense Agent when the phone is back online.
features.status_evidence_quote: But be mindful because it's still in preview.
caveats: No local processing; receipts are only processed after the connection returns
Only some parts of the flow work offline
prerequisites: Expense Agent mobile app installed on iOS or Android

features.name: Expense submission and approval on mobile
features.description: The mobile app supports submitting expense reports to the approver and the full approver experience. Approvers can review single expenses, check compliance issues on flagged ones, override them and approve the report.
features.status_evidence_quote: But be mindful because it's still in preview.
prerequisites: Business Central environment that supports the Expense Agent

features.name: Expense Agent mobile app availability (iOS and Android beta)
features.description: The app can be downloaded today for iOS or Android, with documentation linked by a QR code. Users must accept beta conditions and need a Business Central environment that supports the Expense Agent.
features.status_evidence_quote: the app is still in beta, which means you will get to accept some beta conditions and beta program
caveats: Some functionality still needs to be figured out and fixed
Users must accept beta conditions before downloading
prerequisites: Business Central environment that supports the Expense Agent
